ios.desc:
Transform your life with the most powerful habit tracking app. Create unlimited habits, track streaks, and achieve your goals with AI-powered features.

Key Features:
- Unlimited Habits: Create as many habits as you need
- Smart Reminders: AI personalized reminder messages that actually work
- Advanced Streak Tracking: Multiple streak types to keep you motivated
- Beautiful Visual Progress: See your progress with intuitive monthly, yearly, and heat map views
- Challenges & Goals: Participate in public challenges to keep yourself accountable
- AI Habit Creation: Generate complete habits from simple text prompts
- Custom Widgets: Multiple home screen widgets for quick habit tracking
- Unlimited Archive: Archive habits without limits to keep your list clean
- Data Privacy: Your data stays secure and private

Start building better habits today. Download Habit Tracker and join thousands of users who have transformed their lives through consistent habit formation.
-----------------
If you choose to upgrade to Habit Tracker Pro, your payment will be charged to your Apple ID account. Your subscription will automatically renew unless you turn off auto-renewal at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can manage or cancel your subscription anytime in your Apple ID Account Settings.
For more information, please review our Privacy Policy at https://vatanachhorn.github.io/HabitTrackerLegal/privacy-policy.html and our Terms of Use at https://vatanachhorn.github.io/HabitTrackerLegal/terms-of-use.html.
